consequence.statement: ApplicationSets with nested selectors may now produce a different set of Applications, because those selectors are always applied.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, check ApplicationSets that use selectors inside nested generators, and confirm the Applications they will generate.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 makes a breaking change so the ApplicationSet controller always applies nested selectors.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence is a one-line commit title. It does not name the ApplicationSet field, generator or setting that controls nested selectors, so the subject cannot be pinned to a specific family or path.; applicability: The evidence does not say which ApplicationSet configuration (generator type or selector field) is affected. It also does not say what earlier versions did, so no predicate can be written.
